hypothesis: A contrarian diagnosis hook will improve three-second hold over an outcome-first hook for this problem-aware audience.

baseline.source: Instagram professional dashboard export for comparable educational reels.

controlled_difference.rationale: Change only the opening claim so a lift can be attributed to hook strategy.

variants.label: Contrarian diagnosis
variants.hook: Your captions are not drifting because of the caption renderer.
variants.packaging: Neutral diagram cover with NOT THE RENDERER headline.

variants.label: Outcome first
variants.hook: This one timing rule keeps every caption and graphic in sync.
variants.packaging: Neutral diagram cover with ONE CLOCK headline.
variants.difference: Leads with the desired result and mechanism.

distribution_plan.audience_split: Use platform-native A/B delivery to comparable randomized audiences.

decision_rule.guardrail_behavior: Do not adopt a hook that lifts hold while reducing completion or saves by more than 5% relative.
